page.layout: One page of text: a heading centred at the top; below it a running approbation paragraph with the signature line of Abbas Ferdinandus Vgheltus; then a decorative rule; then the Imprimatur of O. Archiepiscopus Patracensis; then a second decorative rule; then the final Imprimatur of F. Raimundus Capifuccus. No margin notes, no page number, no running head.

main_text.head: APPROBATIO.
main_text.p: IVbente Reuerendiffimo P. Raimunda Capifucco sacri Apostolici Palatij Magistro, legi Tractatum hunc De Synodo Octaua Photiana, a Clarissimo viro Leone Allatio Bibliothecae Vaticanae Primo Custode compositum. Quod ob multiplicem Ecclesiasticae veritatis elucidationem, dignum existimo, quod typis in lucem edatur, cum nihil fidei moribusque Christianis aduersum contineat. Sed potius ad eruditionem, ac puritatem Ecclesiasticam augendam non leue fulcimentum allaturum videatur. Roma. 20. Octobris 1661[?].
D. Ferdinandus Vghellus Abbas Ordinis Cistercienfis.

p.i: Imprimatur, si videbitur Reuerendiff. Patri Magistro Sac. Palatij Apostolici.
F. Raimundus Capifuccus Sac. Palatij Apostol. Mag. Ord. Praedicatorum.

page.notes: The date "1661" is partly obscured by a stain and reads as "166r" at the scan; marked [?]. The decorative rules between the approbations are ornaments, not text, and are omitted. The printed "Ciftercienfis" and "Ecclefiaftica" have long s, transcribed as plain s. The "I" of "IVbente" is a large initial joined to the word as printed. The signature "Vghellus" is copied as printed; the faint marks over "Vgheflus" and the stain on the left are not text. The Patracensis line is partly faded and may read "Patracenfis" as printed; the scan is not fully clear there.
